integrity: Reconstructed the exact binomial transition recursion from the published standard and Greenwood rules. The proof uses exact polynomial identities, strictly positive Bernstein-basis certificates, monotone calibration, and a ratio comparison; checker independently derives and replays each identity. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exactly four persons per household, one-day infectious period, one simultaneous import pulse followed by no global infection
Strict ordering is of expected isolated-household final infection fractions, not coupled-population major epidemic sizes, nor of final-size distributions
One-seed reproduction-number calibration assumes the same global offspring-contact intensity, which may lie on either side of threshold
title: A strict four-person household seeding gap under matched reproduction numbers
